newsitem.title: USA: CME August pork bellies up limit, new highs set.
newsitem.headline: CME August pork bellies up limit, new highs set.

text.p: August CME pork belly futures ran up the 3.000 cent-per-lb daily limit and other months were up sharply and set new contract highs.

Traders cited rising cash belly prices as the catalyst for the gains, as well as reduced hog slaughter this week and light product storings as reasons for the persistent support. Recent increased export demand was also cited.
Bellies were up 2.475 to 3.000 cents per lb with August up limit at 91.375 cents, a new contract high. May was up the least at 94.600 cents after setting a new high of 94.900 cents.
